notes.title: ​Game Update 1.0.3: Enhanced Content Quality!
notes.content:
Update Highlights:

Evidence System Improvements

- Refined the structure of evidence collection to enhance logical consistency

- Adjusted the sequence of information discovery to feel more natural

- Improved connections between events and related evidence

Character Enhancements

- Refined character context and motivation to better align with story events

- Deepened character development for more immersive storytelling

- Polished dialogue to improve authenticity and natural flow

This update significantly enriches the gameplay experience, bringing more coherence, emotional impact, and player engagement!
